description: This file implements a thread-safe pseudorandom bit generator pool (RandenPool) using internal classes and functions, including thread-local and pool management logic, for the Abseil C++ library.

classes.name: RandenPoolEntry
classes.description: A thread-safe pseudorandom bit generator class used internally within RandenPool, managing state, refill, and byte filling operations.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the RandenPoolEntry with seed data.

methods.name: Fill
methods.description: Fills a byte buffer with random data.

methods.name: Generate
methods.description: Generates a random value of type T.

methods.name: MaybeRefill
methods.description: Refills the internal state if exhausted.
